subject: Phased commitment unlock & true-up playbook
messages:
From: Julia Park <julia@aperture.ai>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: legal@aperture.ai
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal — request to phase unlocks and true-up cadence

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the renewal packet. We reviewed the numbers with finance and engineering and we have two asks to make the renewal workable for Q4 planning:

1) Can we pull forward the first 25% of the additional committed tokens to kick in month 1 rather than month 3? That helps our product team start early.
2) We need a clear true-up cadence (monthly vs quarterly) and an explicit cap on overage rate during the first year while we build caching/controls.

We'd like a one-page amendment outlining the phased unlock schedule + a short true-up playbook that calls out who owns reporting and the invoice timing. Legal is looped for timing constraints.

Would appreciate a short call today if possible — we want to get to signature before our board meeting in mid-August.

Thanks,
Julia
VP Product, Aperture AI

From: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Julia Park <julia@aperture.ai>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal — request to phase unlocks and true-up cadence

Julia — thanks for the clear asks. We're aligned in principle. Proposed next steps:

- I'll draft a concise amendment that describes a three-step phased unlock (25% immediate, 50% at month 3, remaining 25% at month 9) and a monthly true-up with a 20% capped overage for year one.
- Kimberly, can you run pricing on the modified ramp and confirm ARR impact and invoice cadence?
- Monica, CS can provide the reporting handoff and the CSV export cadence (monthly close + 7 business days).
- Marcus, legal — can you give a 24h review on a short amendment template?

If that looks fine to you, let's do a 30-min alignment call at 11:30 PT. I can send a calendar invite.

—Rishi
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference

From: kimberly.park@redwood.ai <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, Julia Park <julia@aperture.ai>
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 11:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal — request to phase unlocks and true-up cadence

Rishi / Julia — quick numbers from finance (high level):

- Baseline renewal (no change): $420k ARR.
- Proposed phased unlock (25% immediate / 50% M3 / 25% M9) with monthly true-up and 20% capped overage results in an effective first-year ARR of ~$484k (inc. conservative overage reserve).
- Invoice cadence: we can split the committed portion into three invoice events aligned with unlocks (month 0, month 3, month 9) and handle true-ups as monthly credits/debits on next invoice.

I'll attach a short workbook with the invoice timing and sample line items. If Aperture wants to keep a single annual invoice we can propose a small premium; that would change the numbers by ~3.2%.

Attachment: proposed-ramp-schedule.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Kimberly Park
Finance — Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference

From: monica.patel@redwood.ai <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Julia Park <julia@aperture.ai>, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal — request to phase unlocks and true-up cadence

Julia — from an operational standpoint here's the short true-up playbook (ready to include in the amendment):

- Reporting owner: Aperture will receive a monthly usage export (CSV) on the 5th of each month covering prior month usage.
- Redwood will produce a reconciliation report within 3 business days of receipt and flag exceptions >5%.
- True-up billing will be applied on the following invoice period (monthly). Any overage credited/debited will be line-itemized with usage artifacts.
- For the 12-month ramp window we cap additional overage charges at 20% of committed monthly tokens; anything above that requires escalation to the account team for manual review.

Attachment referenced: redwood-amendment-draft.pdf (draft amendment with playbook embedded)

Happy to walk through the CSV schema on our call.

Monica Patel
Customer Success — Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Julia Park <julia@aperture.ai>, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, kimberly.park@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 6 Aug 2026 16:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal — request to phase unlocks and true-up cadence

Julia / team — Legal sign-off from our side with two small edits:

1) Define a 30-day cure period for disputes arising from billing true-ups.
2) Add a short clause that allows Redwood to propose a one-time interim invoice correction if a systemic ingestion/reporting error is discovered.

If Aperture is comfortable with those items, we can finalize the amendment and route to DocuSign today.

Marcus Lin
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

On Thu, 5 Aug 2026 at 10:12 AM Julia Park <julia@aperture.ai> wrote:
> Thanks everyone — the playbook looks straightforward. We accept the phased unlock as proposed with the monthly true-up and 20% cap for year one.
> 
> Two quick asks from legal: can you add the 30-day dispute window and a short escalation path to Redwood account lead for anything >50% monthly variance?
> 
> If you add those, we are good to sign.
> 
> Julia
> VP Product, Aperture AI
